criterion_text: At both listeners, incomplete/unauthed handshake attempts and invalid/oversized HTTP/WS requests are bounded/rejected; the existing Agent #2653 admission guarantee and MCP Bearer/Origin/Host restrictions remain effective, while Server gains an equivalent bounded pre-auth path.

verifiers.summary: The HTTP listener bounds every request head (including the idle keep-alive wait) without cutting a streaming response body

evidence.value: 5a804640f262aa54208f6cbecd53a1a8dca6105e: a keep-alive connection that went idle after one response and one that sent a partial second request were both closed at the per-request header deadline, while a streamed body longer than that deadline was delivered in full

verifiers.summary: Agent upgraded sockets are bounded by an absolute PendingAuth deadline and a separate pending-auth concurrency budget

evidence.value: 5a804640f262aa54208f6cbecd53a1a8dca6105e: an upgraded Agent P2P socket closed at its absolute auth deadline despite a refused authentication and continuous Ping frames; a second upgrade was refused 503 while the only pending-auth slot was held, and a successful client.auth returned the slot

verifiers.summary: Server upgraded sockets are bounded by an absolute PendingAuth deadline and a separate pending-auth concurrency budget

evidence.value: 5a804640f262aa54208f6cbecd53a1a8dca6105e: an upgraded Server socket closed at its absolute auth deadline despite continuous Ping frames; a second upgrade was refused 503 while the only pending-auth slot was held, and a successful server.auth returned the slot
